source_summary: Monochrome ink-and-light-wash Chinese landscape with towering craggy mountains, misty water, wooded cliffs, pavilions and hamlets; seals, calligraphy, borders, and paper texture are excluded from motif extraction.

motifs.name: central_cliff_massif
motifs.description: Isolate the dominant central mountain complex: tall vertical cliffs, dark pine-topped ridgelines, split ravines, and mist-veiled lower slopes. Exclude the pavilion village and foreground trees below.
must_preserve: layered axe-cut and hemp-fiber rock strokes
dark ink washes on cliff faces
pale vertical ravine reserves
pine-needle silhouettes along crests
soft mist edges cutting across the lower mountain
small dotted foliage accents on ledges

motifs.name: left_misty_peak_cluster
motifs.description: Isolate the left middle-distance group of mist-surrounded peaks: rounded dark monoliths at far left and the taller jagged peak with a small receding ridge behind it.
must_preserve: soft diluted wash on rounded peaks
jagged dark crest of the tall peak
thin receding ridge line behind the main peak
horizontal mist bands partially obscuring bases
subtle water-atmosphere transitions

motifs.name: right_islet_peak_chain
motifs.description: Isolate the small right middle-distance island mountains and narrow water gap behind the main massif, including the slender detached peak and two clustered rocky islets.
must_preserve: tiny pine strokes on the island crests
mist-softened lower edges
thin horizontal waterline washes
dark compact rock texture on the clustered peaks
slender vertical silhouette of the detached peak

motifs.name: left_wooded_rock_promontory
motifs.description: Isolate the left-middle wooded rocky promontory with an arched cliff opening, dense trees on top, and shrubs descending along the slope.
must_preserve: dark clustered tree crowns with individual leaf dots
vertical trunks and twig linework
rock arch contour and pale interior wash
textured cliff strokes under the trees
mist-softened lower slope
small shrubs clinging to ledges

motifs.name: midright_pavilion_compound
motifs.description: Isolate the mid-right pavilion compound nestled among trees at the foot of the cliffs: layered tiled roofs, rectangular walls, and surrounding bamboo-like foliage.
must_preserve: precise roof geometry with parallel eave lines
rectangular wall and window linework
light tan roof wash accents
surrounding vertical trunks and fine foliage
rocky slope behind the buildings
misty clearing separating architecture from cliff

motifs.name: foreground_bamboo_tree_screen
motifs.description: Isolate the dense foreground screen of tall leafy trees and bamboo-like growth in the center-right, rising in front of the cliffs and partially screening the settlement.
must_preserve: repeating leaf clusters and dark ink dots
slender vertical trunks
branching twig networks
layered canopy masses in varied ink density
overlapping foliage silhouettes
washed shadow at the tree bases

motifs.name: lower_right_hamlet_figures
motifs.description: Isolate the lower-right hamlet with thatched houses, fenced enclosure, tiny human figures, courtyard spaces, and nearby trees. Exclude the outer border and any seals.
must_preserve: thatched roof striations
straight fence and wall linework
small seated and standing figure silhouettes
door and eave details
pale courtyard wash
nearby tree crowns and trunks framing the houses

motifs.name: lower_left_river_gorge_boat
motifs.description: Isolate the lower-left river gorge with steep banks, dark rocks, flowing water lines, and the small dark boat-like form near the rocks.
must_preserve: thin horizontal ripples and current lines
dark boulders at the water edge
soft washed river surface
steep pale cliff walls fading into mist
small dark boat form beside the rocks
sparse shrubs and grasses along the bank

planning_prompt:
Analyze this Chinese landscape painting as a source for a motif bank.

Create exactly 8 reusable motifs. Return JSON only.

For each motif:
- Use a short snake_case name.
- Describe what should be isolated.
- Provide a normalized bbox as [x, y, width, height], where 0,0 is the top-left of the full image.
- Include all visible brushwork for that motif, but do not include unrelated neighboring motifs.
- Prefer motifs that can be recombined into a new coherent Chinese painting: mountains, hillsides, village clusters, pavilion groups, water/lotus surfaces, bridges, scholar figures, boats, clouds, rocks, shrubs, pines, willows, bamboo.
- Capture details that must be preserved: linework, wash texture, roof geometry, tree needles, rock texture, mist edges, and color accents.

Do not invent objects that are not visible in the source image.
Do not include calligraphy, seals, labels, borders, or paper texture as motifs unless explicitly requested.
